{{Quote|We are a poor planet.|[[Hissal]]|<ref name="Han Solo and the Lost Legacy">''[[Han Solo and the Lost Legacy]]''</ref>}}
'''Brigia''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Tion Hegemony/Legends|Tion Hegemony]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]], and the [[Brigian]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]].

==Description==
Brigia was a blue planet that was inhabited by tall, purple-skinned humanoids: the [[Brigian]]s.<ref name="TCSWE" />

It was a poor and retrogressive world,<ref name="TCSWE" /> economically dominated by the [[Pakuuni/Legends|Pakuuni]].<ref name="Xim Week" /> However, the planet's rulers refused any external assistance.<ref name="TCSWE" />

==History==
===Early history===
One of the member-worlds of the [[Kingdom of Cron]], it was absorbed into [[Xim's empire|Xim's Empire]]. After the empire collapsed, it would continue to thrive as a world of the [[Honorable Union of Desevro and Tion|Honorable Union of Desevro & Tion]], eventually being part of the [[Tion Hegemony/Legends|Tion Hegemony]] when the Tion Cluster joined the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]].<ref name="Xim Week" />

In the Republic's final years, the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]] worlds joined the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|CIS]] and were later members of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Xim Week" />

About two years before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], a small group of colonists left Brigia and founded [[New Brigia]], a [[Chromite/Legends|chromite]]-mining operation located just within the borders of the [[Koornacht Cluster/Legends|Koornacht Cluster]].<ref name="TCSWE" />

[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] were hired by the [[University of Rudrig/Legends|University of Rudrig]] to deliver the necessary teaching supplies to Brigia, but the Brigian government attempted to intervene.<ref name="TCSWE" />

===Galactic Civil War===
Early in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Brigia was once home to the [[Brigia Rebel base|main Rebel base]] after [[Chrellis]].<ref name="TCSWE" /> The planet was abandoned by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]] when they correctly suspected that the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] was going to [[Battle of Brigia (Galactic Civil War)|attack]] it. This was based on information gathered about [[Operation Strike Fear]].<ref name="X-wing" />

The evacuation was done with the assistance of [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Squadron]] and [[Gold Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Gold Squadron]]. All equipment and personnel were loaded aboard all available transports, like the frigate ''[[Fugazi]]'' and corvette ''[[Sonnel]]'' etc. Important persons boarded the shuttle group [[Arroyo]] while the wounded from the evacuation operation were transferred to frigate [[Redemption/Legends|''Redemption'']].<ref name="X-wing" />

===Yuuzhan Vong War===
During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] invaded Brigia. The native Brigians resisted at first, though they were eventually forced to go underground and begin a guerrilla war. The desperate Brigians pleaded with the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] for help, though the business-minded organization ignored them. In the end, the surviving Brigians were enslaved and inserted with [[Yorik-Kul]] implants.<ref name="AoC1" />

The planet was [[Terraforming/Legends|Vongformed]], but much of the ecological changes seemed to retreat within the next decade, leading scientists to fear the bioweapon [[Alpha Red]] had somehow been introduced from neighboring planet [[Caluula/Legends|Caluula]]. Scientists monitored the planet carefully since then.<ref name="Xim Week" />

==Behind the scenes==
Brigia first appeared in the [[1980]] novel ''[[Han Solo and the Lost Legacy]]''. The [[1993]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: X-Wing (video game)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']] features a [[Battle of Brigia (Galactic Civil War)|battle]] during [[Operation Strike Fear]] above a planet called Briggia. "Brigia" and "Briggia" received separate entries in [[1998]]'s ''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' and [[2008]]'s ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' but were considered to be the same planet in [[2009]]'s ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''.<ref name="JCF">{{JCFCite|url=posts/31147051|board=Literature|thread=The Essential Atlas and Galactic Cartography: Official Discussion|user=[[Jason Fry|jasonfry]]|date=2010-08-05|time=6:25 AM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20200802120554/https://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-essential-atlas-and-galactic-cartography-official-discussion.21938930/page-149}}</ref>
